scenario.name: Harbor Safety Monitoring System
scenario.context: Fictional civilian harbor monitoring demonstrator. Supports operators with equipment health and environmental alerts.
assumptions: No autonomous control of physical equipment

requirements.title: Sensor availability
requirements.statement: The system shall display the health of each connected environmental sensor within 10 seconds of a status change.

requirements.title: Operator acknowledgement
requirements.statement: The system shall allow an operator to acknowledge an active alert and record its timestamp.

requirements.title: Audit retention
requirements.statement: The system shall retain alert acknowledgement records for at least 30 days.

requirements.title: Degraded mode
requirements.statement: The system shall indicate degraded status when sensor input becomes unavailable.

requirements.title: Maintenance export
requirements.statement: The system shall export a maintenance summary in a human-readable format.

requirements.title: Role permissions
requirements.statement: The system shall restrict configuration changes to authorized maintenance roles.

components.name: Alert engine
components.description: Evaluates thresholds and degraded input states

components.name: Event store
components.description: Stores timestamped events and audit evidence

risks.name: Stale sensor status shown as current
Alert acknowledgement not recorded
risks.mitigation: Durable audit event and retry handling

risks.name: Unauthorized configuration change
risks.mitigation: Role checks and immutable audit records
